name: Error summary
summary: At the top of a page with more than one field. On submit it lists every error and takes focus; each link moves focus to its field.

when: On pages with more than one field, when submitting finds errors.

whenNot.text: On pages with one field: the field's own message is enough.

anatomy.description: One per error, with the field's message, linking to the field.

props.name: errors
props.description: The errors, in the order of the fields.
props.items: message, and target: the field's id

states.name: Shown
states.description: The heading and a link per error, focused after submit.

accessibility.role: a focusable region, labelled by its heading
accessibility.name: Its heading.
screenReader: Read when it takes focus on submit: the heading, then each error.
notes: Call show(errors) on submit to fill it and move focus to it. Updating errors directly as people fix them doesn't move focus.

related.relationship: The same messages, under each field.

guidelines: Each link uses the field's own message, word for word.

dosAndDonts.do: Move focus to it on submit.
